accountDeletion.title: Delete your QuantaEdge account
accountDeletion.intro: Submit a request to delete your account and associated personal data. Linked learner access and necessary record-retention obligations must be reviewed before deletion can be completed.
accountDeletion.retention: Payment, invoice, certificate, and security/audit records may be retained only where there is a lawful and justified reason. Submitting a request does not mean deletion is complete.
accountDeletion.notSignedIn: Sign in securely to submit or check an account-deletion request. You do not need to reinstall the Android app.
accountDeletion.statusExplanation: Your request has been received, but deletion is not complete yet. You can cancel it before processing is completed.
accountDeletion.statusNeedsSupport: Support is needed for this request
accountDeletion.confirmationLabel: Type DELETE to confirm your request
accountDeletion.confirmationMismatch: Type DELETE exactly as shown to continue.
accountDeletion.includeChildren: Include all {count} linked child account(s) in this deletion request.
accountDeletion.childTransferNote: If a child account must be kept, stop before submitting and arrange a verified guardian transfer. A child's access must not be left without a safe guardian arrangement.
accountDeletion.requestAccepted: Your request was received. This is not confirmation that deletion is complete. You can check its status here and cancel before processing finishes.
accountDeletion.error: We could not complete that action. Refresh and try again.
accountDeletion.childrenRequired: This account has {count} linked child account(s). Confirm that all are included, or stop and arrange a verified guardian transfer before requesting deletion.
accountDeletion.externalNote: You can submit this request from the website even when you no longer have the Android app. Some financial or security records may be retained only for a disclosed, justified reason.
admin.lifecycle.deletionDescription: Review a request and inspect its linked records before any irreversible action.
admin.lifecycle.deletionNoRequests: No account-deletion requests are waiting in this queue.
admin.lifecycle.deletionAssessmentBlocke: Review required; no data has been erased.
admin.lifecycle.deletionNoErasure: This report is read-only. It never erases data or marks a request complete. Every linked record and retention basis must be reviewed first.
admin.lifecycle.deletionChildSetChanged: The linked-child list changed after the request. Resolve that difference before deletion.
accountDeletion.verifyIdentityDescriptio: Before recording this request, confirm your identity with a saved verified sign-in method. Verification expires in 10 minutes.
accountDeletion.otpSent: A code was sent to your verified mobile ending in {lastFour}.
accountDeletion.verifyIdentityFailed: Identity verification could not be completed. Try again or choose manual review.
accountDeletion.identityVerified: Identity verified. You can now submit the request.
accountDeletion.verifyIdentityFirst: Verify your identity or select manual identity review before submitting.
accountDeletion.verifiedGoogle: Reconfirm the Google account already linked to this account.
accountDeletion.noVerifiedMethod: No verified mobile or linked Google identity is available. Choose manual identity review.
accountDeletion.manualReviewLabel: I cannot use these verification methods. Please review my identity manually before processing deletion.
accountDeletion.manualReviewNotice: Manual identity review is required. Your account will not be deleted until the review is completed.
accountDeletion.reasonQuestionDescriptio: Tell us why you want to delete the account. Do not include passwords, OTPs or identity-document numbers.
accountDeletion.reason.noLongerNeeded: I no longer need this account
accountDeletion.reason.movingService: I am moving to another service
accountDeletion.reasonDetailsLabel: Additional explanation (optional unless you choose Other)
accountDeletion.reasonRequired: Choose a reason and add an explanation when selecting Other.
accountDeletion.parentBlocked: This parent account cannot submit a deletion request while active parent-managed child accounts remain linked.
accountDeletion.childDeletionNotComplete: A child deletion request is not the same as completed deletion. Your parent account stays active until each child is safely independent or the child account is resolved by an authorized process.
accountDeletion.childAdultVerified: Over-18 eligibility is verified. The adult learner must complete the independent-account conversion flow; a guardian cannot delete that account for them.
accountDeletion.childAdultVerificationPe: Over-18 status is not currently verified. A guardian-requested child deletion remains subject to staff review and does not delete data immediately.
accountDeletion.childRequestButton: Request deletion of this child account
accountDeletion.childRequestAccepted: The child deletion request was recorded. The parent account remains blocked until the child account is actually resolved.
accountDeletion.childRequestAlreadyPendi: A child deletion request is already waiting for review. The parent account remains blocked.
accountDeletion.childRequestStatus: Child deletion request status: {status}. The parent account remains blocked.
accountDeletion.childIndependentConversi: This child has verified adult eligibility. Ask them to sign in to their own learner session and complete independent-account conversion. They cannot be deleted by a guardian.
accountDeletion.childRequestFailed: Could not submit the child deletion request. Refresh and try again.
accountDeletion.childAgeReviewRequired: A reviewer must confirm whether this child is under 18 before a guardian deletion request can be submitted.
